title: Fit Before You Buy
duration: 2 hours now, 45 minutes when the bike arrives
bestFor: anyone about to buy a road, gravel, or tri bike who wants the right frame size, stem, bars, cranks, and saddle before the order goes in.
includes: Full assessment and dynamic fit on our adjustable fit bike, no bike required
Your position as X and Y coordinates, so any brand can be checked against it
Shortlist of frames that fit, at your budget, checked against a database of 18,000 bikes
Component spec sheet to hand to the shop or builder
Final setup session on the new bike, included
